This petition under Article 226 of the Constitution of India read with Section 528 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 seeks quashing of FIR No. 269/2025 dated 05th August, 2025,
registered at P.S Janakpuri, Delhi, under Sections 498A/406/34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.
Mr. Amol Sinha, ASC for the State, accepts notice.
3. Status Report be filed before the next date of hearing.
